verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows Google Cloud offers a first-party managed Kubernetes service: GKE is praised as 'technically amazing', users mention Kubernetes clusters in the console, and a hands-on report uses `gcloud container clusters get-credentials`. However, nothing in the pack documents GKE's upgrade policy or autoscaling, which are explicit parts of the story. missing for 10: first-party GKE documentation, documented upgrade policy (release channels/maintenance windows), documented cluster/node/pod autoscaling, independent corroboration of upgrade and autoscaling behavior
